summary: P0 Bug Fix Verified: Subscription limit enforcement on /api/knowledge-base/add-to-board now working correctly. After admin downgrades user from Premium to Basic, the endpoint properly returns 403 with subscription_limit error. Frontend displays proper error messages (not [object Object]) and shows UpgradeModal.
passed_tests: POST /api/knowledge-base/add-to-board returns 403 with subscription_limit error when Basic user is at school limit (15/5)
POST /api/knowledge-base/add-to-board succeeds on Premium plan (unlimited schools)
P0 BUG FIX: After admin downgrades user from Premium to Basic via PUT /api/admin/subscriptions/user_public_default, add-to-board is correctly blocked with 403
POST /api/programs also enforces school limits (existing check verified)
GET /api/subscription returns correct tier after admin change (basic/pro/premium)
403 error contains all required fields: error, feature, message, current, limit, upgrade_to
PUT /api/admin/subscriptions/{user_id} changes plan and creates audit log
Frontend: Toast shows proper message 'You've reached your Basic plan limit of 5 schools. Upgrade to track more.' (NOT [object Object])
Frontend: UpgradeModal appears correctly with 3 tier cards when subscription limit 403 is returned
Frontend: Basic tier shows 'Current Plan', Pro tier shows 'RECOMMENDED' badge
test_credentials: No credentials needed - auth is MOCKED (get_current_user returns static user user_public_default)
seed_data_creation: User has 15 schools on board - above Basic tier limit of 5, used for testing limit enforcement
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 bug fix verified. Key endpoints: POST /api/knowledge-base/add-to-board (now enforces school limits), PUT /api/admin/subscriptions/{user_id} (changes plan), GET /api/subscription (returns current tier). Frontend data-testids: add-to-board-{school-name}, upgrade-modal. The fix added 2 lines to knowledge.py: subscription = await get_user_subscription(tenant_id) and await enforce_school_limit(tenant_id, subscription). User restored to premium after tests.
verified_api_endpoints: POST /api/knowledge-base/add-to-board - Now enforces school limits (P0 FIX)
GET /api/subscription - Returns correct tier after admin change
PUT /api/admin/subscriptions/{user_id} - Changes user plan with audit logging

p0_bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Added enforce_school_limit() check to add_to_board endpoint (lines 35-36 in knowledge.py)
p0_bug_fix_verification.verification_result: PASS - Endpoint now returns 403 subscription_limit error when at limit
